descriptionChirho: A plague or divine affliction sent as judgment, especially the catastrophic plagues in the book of Revelation poured out upon the earth (Rev 9:18,20, 11:6, 15:1,6,8, 16:9,21, 18:4,8, 21:9, 22:18).
A wound or fatal injury inflicted on a person or beast, particularly the mortal wound of the beast in Revelation (Rev 13:3,12,14).
A physical blow, beating, or stripe inflicted by humans, as in flogging or assault (Luke 10:30, 12:48, Acts 16:23,33, 2 Cor 6:5, 11:23).
